subject: general
question: What is the name of the programme that supports AI-based learning in government schools?
solution:
The correct answer is __**FLN-AXL**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **FLN-AXL** is an AI-based learning program initiated to enhance foundational literacy and numeracy (FLN) skills in government schools across India.
 
• The program aligns with the goals of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, which emphasizes improving basic education and leveraging technology in learning.
 
• FLN-AXL integrates artificial intelligence tools to personalize learning experiences, making them engaging and effective for young learners.
 
• This initiative aims to address gaps in foundational literacy and numeracy, which are critical for the overall development and future learning of students.
 
• It is implemented in collaboration with state governments, ensuring scalability and adaptation to local languages and contexts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN):**

 
 
• FLN refers to the ability of children to read with comprehension and perform basic mathematical operations.
 
• It is a key focus area under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, which aims to ensure that all children achieve FLN by Grade 3.
 
 
 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020:**
 
 
• The NEP 2020 emphasizes the use of technology in education, including AI, to improve teaching and learning outcomes.
 
• It aims to transform the Indian education system by 2030, focusing on equity, quality, and accessibility.
 
 
 
• **Artificial Intelligence in Education:**
 
 
• AI is increasingly being used to personalize learning, provide real-time feedback, and adapt content to the needs of individual students.
 
• AI-based tools can analyze learning patterns and recommend areas of improvement, enhancing the overall efficacy of education.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives in Education:**
 
 
• The Government of India has launched several programs, such as Samagra Shiksha and Digital India, to improve access to quality education.
 
• These initiatives focus on integrating technology and modern teaching methods in schools.
 
 
 
• **Role of Technology in Foundational Learning:**
 
 
• Technology helps bridge learning gaps by providing interactive and engaging content for students.
 
• It enables teachers to track progress and customize teaching strategies according to individual learning needs.
